name: Ashish Vaswani
bio: Ashish Vaswani is co-founder and CEO of Essential AI and a co-author of the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need," which introduced the Transformer. Vaswani previously worked at Google Brain and co-founded Adept AI. Essential AI released its first open model, the 8B-parameter Rnj-1, under an Apache 2.0 license in December 2025.
known_for: Co-founder and CEO of Essential AI
